newsitem.title: USA: Japanese girl awaits heart transplant in California.
newsitem.headline: Japanese girl awaits heart transplant in California.

text.p: An 8-year-old Japanese girl awaiting a heart transplant was in critical condition on Monday, a UCLA Medical Centre spokeswoman said.
Roxanne Moster, a spokeswoman for the UCLA Medical Centre, said Miyuki Monobe was flown to Los Angeles from Japan on Saturday and admitted to UCLA for evaluation.

Moster said the girl was placed on a waiting list but it was not known when a heart would be available. "It could be hours or a month," she said, adding that the child, who is currently on a ventilator, may soon require an artificial heart lung machine if she is not stablized.

Pediatric cardiologist Juan Alejos conducted the tests on the girl, who was born with with a hole in her heart and a narrow aorta -- the main artery that carries blood from the heart to the rest of the body. The girl's parents said Miyuki had already undergone four operations in Japan and that doctors there told them she needs a transplant to survive.
